nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_volatility_resolution_238m
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both compare dispersion across the session.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor compares close-return variance by time; Campaign128 compares volume-weighted cross-bar transaction-price interquartile dispersion and reads neither close nor return.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_transaction_vwap_consensus_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both use bar transaction price amount/volume with volume weights.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor is a whole-day geometric-to-arithmetic mean ratio. Campaign128 separately estimates morning and afternoon weighted IQRs and measures their temporal contraction; it does not reuse the mean-ratio statistic.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_volume_weighted_transaction_price_bowley_skew_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both use left-continuous volume-weighted transaction-price quantiles.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor measures full-day distribution asymmetry using Q25/Q50/Q75. Campaign128 excludes the median, measures the IQR scale in each fixed half, and compares morning against afternoon. No skew-change alternative is admitted.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_amount_profile_similarity_120b
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both have a fixed morning/afternoon split and use amount-related data.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor compares normalized amount-clock profiles. Campaign128 uses amount only with volume to obtain per-bar transaction prices and uses volume as distribution mass; it does not compare clock profiles.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_half_session_chord_adherence_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: Chord adherence measures ordered close-path deviation from two endpoint chords. Campaign128 is order-invariant within each half and reads no close or path endpoints.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_transaction_price_path_confirmation_238p
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both derive a transaction price from amount and volume.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor uses ordered adjacent transaction-price path confirmation. Campaign128 discards within-half order after exact half assignment and measures weighted distribution dispersion.
